title: なぜなら
meaning: because: a reason for or to do (x).
meaning_example: （私は日本にいきまして、）なぜなら、三人の友達が日本にいたからです。I went to japan, because I had three friends living there.

 （私は日本にいきまして、）なぜなら、三人の友達が日本にいたからです。I went to japan, because I had three friends living there.
sections.body_html:
because: a reason for or to do (x).
（私は日本にいきまして、）なぜなら、三人の友達が日本にいたからです。I went to japan, because I had three friends living there.

comments.text:
The example for this grammar is strange Japanese.

日本に行きました - I went to Japan
三人の友達 - Three friends

なぜなら is used to explain the reason why a certain action was talken. It is often used in speeches and lectures and almost always paired with 〜からだ。
